records.text: Alex Ferguson, Scottish football manager and former player, was born on December 31, 1941.
records.textJa: Alex Ferguson（Scottish football manager and former player）は1941年12月31日に生まれた。

records.text: On December 31, 1961, Green Bay Packers won the 1961 NFL Championship, beating New York Giants 37–0 at City Stadium, Green Bay. It was their 7th title. They had finished the regular season 11–3–0.
records.textJa: 1961年12月31日、Green Bay Packersが1961年のNFL選手権でNew York Giantsに37対0で勝った（City Stadium、Green Bay）。通算7度目の優勝。レギュラーシーズンの成績は11–3–0。

records.text: Roberto Clemente, the Pittsburgh Pirates right fielder and two-time World Series winner, died on December 31, 1972, aged 38.
records.textJa: Roberto Clemente（Pittsburgh Piratesの右翼手、two-time World Series winner）が1972年12月31日に38歳で死去した。

records.text: Kaseya Center in Miami opened on December 31, 1999; home of the Miami Heat; it hosted 2005 Larry O'Brien Championship Trophy.
records.textJa: Kaseya Centerが1999年12月31日に開場した（Miami）。Miami Heatの本拠地。2005 Larry O'Brien Championship Trophyを開催。
